question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2. **
solution: The correct answer is: **While** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • "**While**" is a conjunction that shows a contrast or a simultaneous action. (एक विरोधाभास या एक साथ होने वाली क्रिया को दर्शाता है) • It is used to connect two clauses that are happening at the same time but in different ways. • **For example**: *I was studying while my sister was watching TV.* • The word "**while**" in this sentence is used to indicate a simultaneous action. • It shows that two actions are happening at the same time: the wings behind him beating in a calming rhythm and the cool air rushing past. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • "**Unless**" is a conjunction that shows a condition that must be met for something else to happen. (एक ऐसी शर्त को दर्शाता है जिसे कुछ और घटित होने के लिए पूरा किया जाना चाहिए) • "**Much**" is an adjective that means a large quantity or degree. (बड़ी मात्रा या डिग्री) • "**Since**" is a conjunction that shows a time period that has passed since a certain event. (किसी निश्चित घटना के बाद बीत चुकी समय अवधि को दर्शाता है) 1b5:Tb05, The correct answer is: **Snapping**
